title: Top of the World
gap: No offerings or guided tours described
blurb: The park offers more than 30 miles of official trails through mature oaks, sycamores, and elderberry trees, with two year-round streams. It is a designated wildlife sanctuary home to many rare and endangered plants and animals. Visitors can enjoy hiking, biking, equestrian trails, bird watching, interpretive programs, picnic areas, restrooms, and scenic overlooks.

hours: Park office hours: Monday – Friday 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; Saturday – Sunday 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.
